items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Anyone’s [Selmer] Mark VI will go for seven or eight grand now.

ctx.x: I can get probably ten thousand dollars for my horn if I add my name to it.
Anyone’s [Selmer] Mark VI will go for seven or eight grand now. The price of those horns just keeps going through the roof.
